mapper.select: SELECT article_id, title, content, user_id, form_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM article WHERE article_id=#{articleId}

SELECT article_id, title, content, user_id, form_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM article WHERE 1=1
AND title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND content LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
ORDER BY article_id DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM article WHERE 1=1
AND title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND content LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
